format: UTF-8 CSV, decimal point, no row index
identifiers: lake_id and episode_id must be read as strings; region_id defines the target cohort.

unit_rules.coverage_pct: 100 * captured independent events / evaluable independent events within the named cohort.
unit_rules.gained_lost_retained_neither: Exact paired event counts relative to the named reference; they sum to the cohort denominator.
unit_rules.gained_pct_lost_pct: 100 * gained or lost events / the full same-cohort event denominator.
unit_rules.difference_pp_net_pp_coverage_change_pp: Coverage differences in percentage points, not relative percent changes.
unit_rules.lower_pp_upper_pp: Original 98.75% paired whole-lake bootstrap interval endpoints for coverage differences; 5,000 resamples.
unit_rules.evaluable_events: Opportunity-supported independent event denominator, not number of lakes.
unit_rules.binary_capture_flags: 0 = event not captured; 1 = event captured, for the indicated method or source-training definition.
unit_rules.historical_q90_ug_L: Pre-2011 lake Chl-a 90th percentile in micrograms per litre; positive continuous concentration.
unit_rules.cumulative_events_gained_lost: Counts at all historical q90 values less than or equal to the current row value.
unit_rules.stratum: below25: q90 <25; 25to75: 25 <=q90 <75; 75plus: q90 >=75 micrograms per litre.
unit_rules.bubble_area: Circle size parameter is 11 square points per event. Triangle size is multiplied by pi/2 to correct unit-marker geometry and share the same actual area-per-event scale; no additive area term.
unit_rules.event_lake_reach: Number of event-bearing lakes with at least one captured event; distinct from event coverage.
unit_rules.score: Uncalibrated saved Multi-window output for one candidate lake and date. Scores are not interpreted as probabilities or compared directly across training strategies.
unit_rules.rank: 1-based within-date descending-score rank, breaking equal-score ties by lake_id.
unit_rules.queue_size: All candidate lakes in the same date-specific queue, not only lakes with evaluated events.
unit_rules.quota: Ceiling of 0.1 times queue_size; integer number of selected candidate lakes.
unit_rules.best_rank_over_quota: Minimum rank/quota across all same-event 31-60-day opportunities, separately under each training strategy. Values <=1 reproduce original event capture exactly.
unit_rules.marginal_histograms: Empirical counts, 24 fixed logarithmic bins spanning 0.009 to 25. Each marginal totals 718 events. No KDE or probability-density estimate.

cohort_rule: Panel a absolute-event cohorts and panel b relative-event cohorts differ. Training comparisons in panels b and c pair the same relative events.

data_files.display_scope: Sixteen target 31-60-day coverages validate event records and exchanges; source-validation and wider-window rows provide supporting data.

data_files.derivation: Exact binary pairing of each comparator with XGBoost within each region; no statistical model.
data_files.display_scope: All twelve gained/lost percentage pairs are drawn in panel a; counts and net differences are included as supporting data.

data_files.derivation: Selected region, event, lake, date and four binary capture fields from the saved target absolute-event records.
data_files.display_scope: All 529 absolute-event records determine the twelve exact method-reference exchanges in panel a.

data_files.derivation: Exact grouping by historical q90 followed by cumulative sums; no fitted trend or density.
data_files.display_scope: Cumulative event counts by historical Chl-a threshold.

data_files.derivation: Exact grouping of the 718 paired relative events by lake; coverage change = 100 * (relative count - absolute count) / event count.
data_files.display_scope: All 258 lakes shown in panel d; point area proportional to event count, with triangle geometry corrected to the same area scale.
All 718 exact paired outcomes validate event-priority quadrants and all lake summaries.

data_files.derivation: Link each of the 718 original event records to all same-lake candidate dates 31-60 days before the event.
data_files.display_scope: All 1,409 eligible links from events to candidate rows, with lead days; used to rebuild the best within-event priority ratios.

data_files.derivation: For each event and training strategy, take the minimum rank/quota across its eligible links. Both coordinates are verified against original paired capture flags.
data_files.display_scope: All 718 paired event priorities and four-state outcomes shown in panel c; original measured coordinates unchanged.

data_files.derivation: Select saved Multi-window scores for both training strategies. Sort by date then lake_id; within-date rank decreasing scores with identifier tie breaking. Quota is ceil(0.1 * complete queue size). Binary rank<=quota flags match both saved selection files exactly.
data_files.display_scope: 21,148 saved candidate score pairs, exact within-date ranks, complete queue sizes, ceiling quotas and capture flags; source records for the priority comparison.

data_files.derivation: Four-state transitions within three background intervals.
data_files.display_scope: All twelve transition cells, including zeros, validate background-interval counts and the high-background losses; no table is drawn.

data_files.derivation: Paired training effects and 98.75% intervals from 5,000 whole-lake resamples.
data_files.display_scope: All eight paired effects and interval endpoints are drawn in panel b; baseline and retrained coverages remain in source data.

panels.a: All twelve absolute-event exchanges relative to XGBoost.
panels.b: All eight relative-training effects and original paired intervals.
panels.c: All 718 event-priority pairs and empirical marginal counts.
panels.d: All 258 lake responses with event-count area encoding.
